Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: What is the situation of the SEN YU garment workers who are on strike and making demands by stop working?Oct 25, 2023
Content:
Around 1,000 workers at the Chinese-owned SEN YU Garment Factory, which opened at Middle Village, BaMaw Secretary Road, Hlaing Thar Yar Township, have stopped work and are making demands.

The workers who sew international brands such as Sinsay, TERRANOVA and P&VV are not satisfied with the fact that they will no longer pay bonuses if they do not meet the standards starting from October, so they stopped working.

The workers are demanding that the HR Manager, who is mainly responsible for the workplace, be dismissed from the job and that to pay their wages as before.

At present, there has been no negotiation between employers and workers, and the workplace has been stopped. We have asked the workers in the workplace about these conditions.

(1)Please explain the current situation.

The current situation is that no one is working in the factory. Since yesterday, October 18th, the employer has suspended and filed the workers. They said that they would call the supers, liters, and supers to come to the office to solve the problem. At first, they asked 2 people to come, but they couldn't let them go. Then, they asked for the leaders to come at 14:00. Haven’t got a response yet.

(2)Are there any authorities taking place in the current workplace?

All the workers are in the factory. It's the 2nd day since we stopped working. There are no inspections upon the workers. Yesterday, some so-called gangsters left from the gate with 2 cars. Going up no down the stairs. I didn't see them holding any guns or with uniforms. They are gangsters’ styles with tattoos. At first, they broadcast that they were from the labor office, but there is not eye-witnessed upon that.

(3)It has been 2 days since the work stoppage, so what would you do next?

Yesterday, it is said that they would allow our demands and just before we leave also said that HR manager will be fired. She went back after 18:00 and it is said that it would be negotiated. And today the letter that reported the workers have found out. They reported to the labor office saying that to help negotiating as the workers can’t be negotiated anymore. At first, they called two young workers to come but the supers and leaders said no and they would go themselves. And this morning they said it will be 14:00 and all workers are here right now. The employer reported to the labor office that we don’t work and also can’t be negotiated.

(4)What are the workers’ demands?

There are 10 demands we appeal, but there are no negotiations upon any of them. They can reply like they would accept 5 of the 10 demands or something. But we heard that they filled us. A factory should give professional fees if they hire a professional worker. But they set hourly targets such as 50 or 100 and said that we would be paid only if we meet the targets. If we were asked 50, we gave and the next day we are appointed to a meet more targets. Its not they reduced, they asked an impossible target and not to pay. It is graded as A, B and C before but they don’t give anymore if the hourly targets they asked were not met.

(5)What rates are currently being paid?

Daily wage of 4,800 MMK and Provisional Allowance 800 MMK. Nothing said upon 1,000 MMK additional allowance which had been expressed. We are only getting daily wage and attendance bonus. There was a professional fee before but it has been abolished and only daily wage and attendance bonus left. Attendance bonus 30,000 MMK and monthly wage 168,000 MMK and that’s all. The factory has been operated for 6 months and they only hired the professionals. All are professionals in their respective fields.

There are day laborers at work. Now, the day laborers have been suspended for about 1 month. I don't know if they planned to do this in advance. EC contract is signed but they don’t give the book and kept it in the factory. It should be given. It should be employer 1 carbon, employee 1 carbon and labor office 1 carbon. We don't have a social security card yet, if someone had one from the previous office, they would have. If they would close the factory and can’t accept the workers’ demands, pay a fair compensation and do it. There is no negotiation committee or labor union in the workplace. By the end of July, we told to form the WCC. But we don’t hear anything just some words meaning that we should follow his will.

Suppose that there are 50 people in a line. If there is a lot to sew on one piece of fabric, the hourly is asked for less. If there is less sewing, then the amount is increased according to the population. Now, the reason we can't negotiate is that there is no expert fee for the knowledge I have. At first, we got paid a grade fee, but the salary doesn’t exile 200,000 MMK as they don’t pay it anymore. We got at the cavity last month and absolutely no in cutting. The supers give upon our professional level at the cavities.

Grade bonus is based upon our proficiency. It depends how much a worker can work and what is their abilities. If they have seniority proficiency, obedience upon the supers and target hits it would be A grade and C grade for absolute newbies who just start to work.

The workers who get A among ABC are proficient. If a worker gets 20 A, she can't be given 20. it can only be given 10, and then you don't have the right to give C, which is more convenient.

A child who gets 300MMK a day will be 30,000 MMK a month 500 MMK for 50,000 MMKand at least 40,000 MMKper month for a worker who should be given 1,200 MMK a day. The workers have no benefits at all. Missing a day costs 4-50,000 MMK cut. Daily wage 5,600 MMK, attendance bonus 20,000 MMK grade bonus is 40,000 MMK for A, 30,000 MMK for B and 20,000 MMK for C.

(7)Why did the workers stop work?

If the fabric is finished in the line, the worker has to stand up and pick up the fabric, or go to the toilet or drink water, then they would shout that who in which line, stand up and walk, 1 time or 2 times, and say that they will make the worker sign a warning if they have to say again and again and those are shouted by a microphone. It started at around 1 o'clock on Tuesday (October 17) and they said that they would give ABC Grades to the children in units. They told us to try that system and make out salaries convenient. So, if they can’t satisfy with us following their one-sided wills, the workers decided to stop work as they can hire those who are convenient with that system. So, the employer shouted with a mic saying that those who stopped working are recorded by CCTV and salaries would be cut.

(8)What difficulties would the workers have as the grade bonus will not be given anymore if the standards are not meet?

Livelihoods became difficult. We have high rice and cooking oil prices. If a bottle of a cooking oil price is 10,000 MMK their cut costs 2 bottle of cooking oil. It doesn’t hit so much for those who have a small family but those who with big family do.

Most workers live in dorms. A dorm at least cost 50,000 to 60,000 MMK a month. They cut half of our dorm rental fees. An A grader can pay half with his own money if 40,000 is cut to 20,000. But as they don’t give even a penny, we have to give the dorm cost ourselves so we would not be able to support our families or eat ourselves.

(9)What will be the main demands?

Yesterday request was to fire the HR Manager Daw Si Si May and to give the grade bonus we deserved. The HR Manager never stands with the workers. We don’t also want to bias only towards either the workers or the employer. We want her to be an integrated person who can negotiated between the workers and the employee. But she only favors the employer and suppress the workers too much. We got grade bonuses, convenient in the work and can negotiate and solve the problems before this manager was hired. But with her grade bonus are no longer paid and she fired the proficient workers with a notice field in the cutting session. And as it looks like those who are not convenient with the workers are going to be fired, there were no negotiations.

Actually, the hourly issue should be decided by the production manager but she is doing whatever she wants to. She acts like firing can be decided by her alone and no need to sign with the Chinese. She manipulates whatever she wants as she can speak Chinese, In the line, the production and the office have differences. Now if the workers are not done quickly, they won't get their wages paid. She said that she would not give much money for the grade bonus but instead by units, but she would give a maximum of 30. How would she pay for the remaining 20? She said she doesn’t know when we asked, At first there is no resolve at all and right now she said that she would revolve but circuitously

Thank you for replying.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: E&P Fashion factory workers are being intimidated inside the factoryOct 25, 2023
Content:
It is known that more than 400 workers of the E&P Fashion Garment Factory which locates on Anaw Ra Htar Road, Industrial Zone (5), Hlaing Thar Yar Township are being threatened inside the factory.

The factory is owned by a Chinese national and employs more than 400 people. It is said that the factory is manufacturing Housexc brands Jean and short-sleeve jackets.

On September 30, the manager of the factory said he will make the workers whom the employer don’t like and who did not calm down not to be able to apply for job in the next and also told that he would label them as PDFs and handle them over to the Junta, according to the workers.

Due to the presence of such threats, the workers feel insecure in the workplace and are working with worries.

Also, all night and all light overtimes are forced with the ground of the importance of the orders and the worker said that they are having a hard time as they were paid by fabric-amount although it was said they would be paid by daily wages.

"When we asked how the salary would be paid, we were told that it would be paid at the rate of 4,800 dailies from the 1st to the 30th. But it changed it to a fabric amount depending payment 5 days after the end of the month. The actual salary and the salary the employer calculated have a gap, so it is not convenient," the worker said.

Although they are not satisfied with the issues in the workplace, it is difficult to file a complaint, the workers are being kept quiet by fear because they are being threatening that they will not be able to get other jobs by using their photos and that they will be arrested by the military.

"The factory was announced to be temporarily closed on the 20th of the 9th month. It reopened on the 2nd of the 10th month. The days of the closure were only paid 2,400 without the consent of the workers. About half of the workers who pointed this out were not asked to work and were asked to sit still," a worker said.

He said that the number of workers who pointed to the payment of only 2,400 days for the factory's temporary holiday was more than 180, but there was no recalculation.

As for the workers’ appeals, they want to request that not to make threats by the manager to have the workers arrested by the military, were not treated with malice to the 187 workers who weren’t asked to work, to repair the toilets, to have clarity upon paying the salary,not to make changes when the pay day gets near, to ask the workers desire before calling all light and all night overtimes and not to forced to work overtime.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: More than 1,000 workers filed a collective demand to fire the HR manager who demanded 60 to 100 cloths per hour.Oct 25, 2023
Content:
More than 1,000 workers in the SEN YU garment factory are making a collective demand. The HR manager is demanding more fabric standards than the workers can sew, and tell them to leave if they can’t accomplish the tasks they assigned and would not be get paid for grade bonus if they don’t meet the fabric standards. So that the workers want the HR manger to be fired.

It is reported that the factory is owned by a Chinese national and located Bamaw Secretary Road, Middle Village, Hlaing Thar Yar Township, Yangon Region. It is also said that the factory is manufacturing international brands such as TERRANOVA and P&VV.

"What is happening right now is that they are protesting because they are unsatisfied with the HR manager. They are not getting paid the wages they deserve. The HR said that the workers will be given only if they meet the hourly target which had already been demanded more. The workers are unable to reach it. It's different from one line to another. Some lines are being asked for 8,90,100 pieces per hour, and the man power requesting over 1,000 just almost the whole factory," said a worker.

“A meeting was called yesterday. The office will handle about the grade bonus of the seamstresses. Grade bonus will only be given when their demand is reached. The HR manager told with a microphone that we will not be given since the second we stop to work and we can leave if we don’t want to work. The HR also summons the supers and all supers in a meeting and told that they will be given the grade bonus as before but the seamstresses’ one will be handled by them. So, it is sure that the supers and all supers are going to pressure us. We would not get paid for that month. And they ask impossible grades too like at least 60 cloths for an hour. Even if we accept the impossible grades, we would be asked more. So that we stop working. Yesterday we leave the workplace at 4:30 without working overtime and inspected at the gate as well,” explained a worker.

“As we filed a collective demand as now, it is said that the HR would be suspended but not exactly known for how many days. The demand we asked was to fire. It is also said that there would be a negotiation with the all supers and cavities representatives. We said our demands. Their response doesn’t match with us. We are complaining because of the impossible fabric standard demands and telling us to leave if we don’t want to work,” added the worker.

The workers said that they ask for the firing of the HR, the raising of the professional fee according to the grades, not reducing grades and cutting attendance bonus for taking legal leaves, the annuity according to the years of service, 5 hours gate pass per week, survey for the workers upon the overtime, WCC which the workers could elect, not to cut the daily wages for the collective demanding days, medic clinic and medicines and taking responsibility for workplace injury and not to fire the workers who participated in the collective demanding.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: GOLDEN FASHION GARMENT FACTORY, cut the benefits of Statutory leave by labeling as absentOct 25, 2023
Content:
The workers of the GOLDEN FASHION Garment Factory told Myanmar Labor News that their statutory leaves are labeled as absent and their rights are being cut.

According to the workers, the GOLDEN FASHION garment factory is operated in Anaw Ra Hta Industrial Zone, Hlaing Thar Yar Township, Yangon District and is owned by a Chinese national.

"We are unable to take a leave. With or without reporting attendance bonus of 10,000 MMK and meal allowance 15,000 MMK and professional fee; all would be cut," the factory workers said.

He said that most of the workers are considered to be absent because they cannot easily get a gate pass for the matter.

"We are paid daily wage 4,800 MMK, overtime wage, professional fee, attendance bonus 20000 MMK and a bag of rice equivalent to meal allowance 30,000 MMK," the workers explained to Myanmar Labor News.

Regarding the leave benefits on working days and holidays, the law stipulated by Myanmar, chapter 3 entitled "Employee has the right to receive the relevant fee or salary according to the type of leave specified by the law for a specified period of time."

Although it is clearly stated in the law, GOLDEN FASHION Garment Factory says that they will cut benefits for taking a leave and they said professional fee 2,400 MMK per day will be given but that expert fee will be cut again if the garment is not completed within the specified time.

"Suppose that the employer appoints 10,000 fabric per machines starting from June. If only 70 percent is completed within the specified date, the expert fee will be cut and it is up to 30 percent," said the workers.

The workers told Myanmar Labor News that the factory asks them impossible fabric standards and pregnant workers are not appointed to work comfortably, and they are being asked to work like ordinary workers.

In addition, the factory did not inform the workers in advance that they would call for overtime.

"They call overtime until 9 p.m. sometimes. They didn’t inform in advanced. They told me that we have to go down overtime (9 o'clock) when we are about to go back to work in the evening and we are not allowed to contact our families about being late," the workers said.

The GOLDEN FASHION factory has been open for almost 2 years but more than 900 workers are using unsanitary toilet water, they told Myanmar Labor News.

It is said that the factory is manufacturing brands such as UNITED COLORS OF BENETTON. There is no labor union in the workplace, but a workplace coordination committee (WCC).

According to the workers, they want to appeal to inform in advanced and to survey upon calling overtime, to easily allowed for taking legal leaves, not to cut from the meal allowance, to give the professional fee as before and not to cut with percentage, to ask only the possible fabric standard and to provide pure water for the toilets.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: 500 MMK fine for missing an entry record at Universal GarmentOct 25, 2023
Content:
Workers told Myanmar Labor News that Universal Garment Factory Universal Apparel Co, Ltd has an attendance machine which records entry and exist and they have to pay 500 Kyats immediately if they are not recorded.

"If someone is not recorded for any kind of reason, they will start yelling for 500 MMK fine with the microphone," said a worker.

"Workers have said that Universal Garment has had that detector for more than 2 years, and that it has been placed at a place where the garment is using as both entrance and exist. The clerks also collect the attendance list, even after recording with the machine" he said.

Even through the clerks list the attendance, the workers still need to pay 500MMK fine if they miss the machine record.

The workers also said that record system is convenient it is convenient for entry but it does not for exist as there is always a crowd and there are many workers who don’t get recorded.

"As for the workers, they have to pay the fine every time the machine doesn’t register them without knowing there is errors. We don't know who is doing what with that money. We are being cut off almost every day as we are not recorded. " a worker said.

Workers said that Universal Garment Factory Universal Apparel Co., Ltd. is located at Ngwe Pinle Industrial Zone, Hlaing Thar and owned by a Korean National.

The factory operates with more than 1,000 workers and manufactures brands such as ELCORTE, MOORES, DUMRP and Dutmp and exports to The United States, Canada and Korea.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Urge for compensation for the death of a pregnant worker's fetus who had a Braxton Hicks contraction at workOct 24, 2023
Content:
It is reported that the death of a female worker's fetus occurred on September 30 as she did not have a chance to give birth on time. The woman is working as a seamstress.

A 7-month pregnant female sewing worker working in Myanmar Yangon Richang Apparel Co,Ltd. (NISHO) garment factory had a pre-labor contractions at 10:00 a.m. and told the production manager that she is going to give a birth. But instead of sending her to the hospital, she was told to take a rest in the lounge, and the pregnant woman cried out that she was about to give a birth asamniotic fluid starts to flow and water breaks, but there was no one to help her.

At 3:00 p.m., the fetus’ head came out, and at 4:00 p.m.,she was taken to Hlaing Thar Yar Hospital, but unfortunately, the baby didn’t survive.

The pregnant female worker was given 2 months maternity leave by Social Security and instructed to return to work on November 21.

"As for the factory officials, if the pregnant woman was taken to the hospital from the time she complained about the pain, the child would definitely survive. The mother could also pass away if it is more delayed. We would like to request that the family of the victim be compensated and healed for the negligence of the factory," the workers demanded.

The factory is located at Shwe Lin Ban Industrial Zone, Hlaing Thar Yar township, Yangon and it is lnown for manufacturing JAVA, CIAOPANIC TYPY, HONEY SUCKLE ROSE, grove, AZUL BY MOUSSY, RODEO CROWNS WIDE BOWL, RIGHT ON, HanGTen, CANADA DUCK DOWN, H-ESSENTIAL, Fieldcore and Nano brands with a total of (800) workers.

In the previous days too, there have been calls for overtime in the factory all light and night, and two workers who worked overtime at night and returned from work at 5 a.m. were robbed on the street in July.

"At that time, the woman was stabbed in the thigh and had to pay the robber her all the money. The employer paid 40,000 for medical expenses. There were about 5 cases of being robbed while returning home from overtime, but they kept calling for overtime," the worker said.

Due to excessive workload and overtime in the workplace there had been a lot of damage to the workers, and there is no difference although the relevant offices came and check.

The workers said they would like to ask the officials to resolve the overtime calls, lack of ferries, and workplace-related harms, as workers' rights are being seriously violated.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Sub factories are closing as mother factories do not pay and workers are on the margin to become unemployedOct 23, 2023
Content:
A worker told Myanmar Labor News that they are on the margin to become unemployed as the Sam Clothing (Myanmar) garment factory from East Dagon Industrial Zone, Yangon, which mainly manufactures the ZARA brand hires some small factories to sub-manufacture the LCW casual brand but does not pay.

"It's been more than 3 months since they appointed to manufacture the cloths. For the first two months, the owner had to find money from somewhere else and never have a dept on the workers. The boss looks good on the workers. For this month, he said that he will pay by selling the machines." said a factory worker.

Sam Clothing (Myanmar) is located in the east of Dagon University Gate, East Dagon Industrial Zone, Yangon and according to DICA's information, it is operating with foreign investment.

One of the managers of the small garment factory said that there are a total of 6 sub-factories that do not receive payment from Sam Clothing (Myanmar) currently and around 500 workers are facing a situation of unemployment.

"The fabrics were sewn according to the process. QC from Sam Clothing (Myanmar) came to check while we were manufacturing. Everything was fine. But they did not even allow to enter the when the payment time reaches," said the administrative staff.

The administrative staff said that the agreement between the two parties to sew the clothes was signed with the letter head of Sam Clothing (Myanmar) and the signed documents were sent via WE chat.

Also, a sub-factory worker said that they have to work 2 days all night and all light at Sam Clothing (Myanmar) factory for LCW casual brand order but there were no wages for those days.

"When the last sewn LCW casual clothes were sent to the Sam Clothing factory, each garment was tested twice. When I checked the clothes at Sam's last time, I worked all light for packing. At that time, didn't want to go as it isn’t my factory. But my boss pardoned and said that to go for the wages. I went there but now; it is known that we still haven't got those." said a female worker.

An administrative employee said that when the contract between Sam Clothing (Myanmar) and the small factories was signed, it was stipulated that the payment must be made within 15 days after the garment was deposited, but now it has been almost 3 months and it has not been paid yet.

They went to Sam Clothing (Myanmar) factory to negotiate about wages, but they did not let them to enter the factory and the factory officer and manager said to speak only with the boss from China.

An administrative employee said that as sub-factories are struggling to pay labor cost, rental fees and social security bills as they don’t get paid.

"At the factory, the bosses and leaders are consulting that to sell the machines and pay the workers. But without those machines, the factory will have to close. So, the workers will become unemployed. During this period, employment is rare. We are worried that the families will be in trouble," said one of the workers.

The workers of some sub-garment factories went to the Sam Clothing (Myanmar) factory to protest about the wages, but the it has not been paid until now, the workers said.

Therefore, the sub-factories seeked assistance from the person or organization in charge of the trademark, labor organizations and related organizations to help prevent workers from becoming unemployed.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Workers were forced to work overtime at the Wonderful Apparel factory without getting paidOct 23, 2023
Content:
At the Chinese-owned Wonderful Apparel factory, workers say they are being forced to work overtime without getting paid and being cut their wages on statutory holidays.

This factory is located in Han City Power Street, Myaung Takar industrial Zone, Mawbe Township. It has been opened and operates with a workforce of over 450 workers.

It is said that they are sewing brands such as KIABI,TROLLKIDS and JACKET. The factory does not have a labor union, but a workplace coordination committee (WCC) has been formed.

''The leaves are given biasedly. Most of us don't get it. We are disparaged for taking leaves upon health issues.The daily wage and attendance bonus are also cut. Grade bonus will be reduced, if we missed a single day'' said a factory worker.

Factory workers have to work from 8:00 am to 12:00 pm every day. In addition, workers are being recruited overtime until 12 o'clock and overtime throughout the night.

The worker, who did not want to be named, said that if the garment quality is unsatisfied, the factory forces the QCs to work overtime for free, and if the QCs refuse, they threaten with firing. If the fabric doesn’t meet the quality standard, each level of QCs are cut-off.

As factory workers, they want to get the legal benefits, to survey for overtime and to pay,Chinese people not to rule directly,not to discriminate upon the grade bonuses and only to cut the grade bonus proportionately for absenting and to provide toilet cleaning services.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Jafon bag factory not giving statutory holidays, use slanders in the workplace and requesting records for absenteeismOct 23, 2023
Content:
According to the workers they are not allowed to enjoy the holidays prescribed by the law at the Jafon factory owned by the Chinese national and Chinese stuffs together with the supers and all leaders use slanders in the work place too. Furthermore, they are also asked for the full fabric standards of the absent workers.

This factory is located in Naga Wun Street, Plot No. 3, Bago Industrial Zone and manufacturing handbag brands such as IPSY and GLAM BAG with more than 200 workforces.

"Casual, medical and social security leaves; nothing is allowed to take. We will be cut off if we take leave. In addition, if two workers take leave in a signal cavity, the rest of them have fill their fabric standards too. Also, the factory closes on two Saturdays in September with their own decision. And later told us to work two days substitute for those two days. We were neither informed nor negotiated back then. When we asked for that, we were told those days were closed because of no tasks and right now is a yes, so we must. And also, the Chinese, supers and leaders usually swear in the workplace,” said a factory worker.

At this factory, overtime is called every day, the workers were forced to work even during the flood in Bagu City. The Ministry of Labor came to inspect violations in the workplace last year, but there has been no change.

"More than a year ago, the Ministry of Labor came to check. But nothing changed and it remained the same as before. Last summer, there were girls who fainted inside the factory. We got medicine at the clinic sometimes and have to go to the office sometimes," he said.

The workers from the Jafon factory wants to be reduced the fabric standards if there is someone absent, to take action in accordance with theemployment agreement for swearing in the workplace, to be allowed for legal leaves, recalculation of substitute days for Saturday and Sunday, (2) days of the first and second week of September with full wages and not to ask for substitute for the days they close because of no tasks without negotiation.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Over 250 entrepreneurs have been suspended from in MGMAOct 23, 2023
Content:
Myanmar Garment Manufacturers Association MGMA announced that more than 250 garment manufacturers who failed to pay their membership fees have been suspended from their membership.

"Membership fee is something that any association in any industry has to pay. Now, rather than failing to pay the annual fee, they will be terminated as a member because they do not cooperate with the association. Those who are actually working in the garment industry will not fail," said a businessman.

It is also known that MGMA has a total of 819 members, and 254 member entrepreneurs have failed to pay their annual dues and have no contact with the association.

According to the statement, the association has repeatedly sent notices to these entrepreneurs to pay the annual membership fee until 2022, but they have not paid and there has been no contact with the association, so they have been suspended from membership.

"Approximately 250 garment factories have ceased operations due to their inability to sustain ongoing activities. The economic landscape is experiencing a decline, and international prospects are also diminishing. Those enterprises that have managed to persevere owe their resilience to their unwavering dedication and diligent work ethic. A friend of mine is operating a piecework seamstress and he too is struggling," said an entrepreneur.

Businesses who fail to pay membership fees will be suspended from membership starting October 9th, and if they wish to remain members, they will be required to pay back the annual fee arrears.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: All supers from H&M brand manufacturing TONG YING HK (Garment) factory are acting like a dictator.Oct 23, 2023
Content:
According to the labours, the all supers at the TONG YING HK (Garment) factory, where the H&M brand is manufactured, are acting in a dictatorial manner, to the point of firing their subordinates over their rights.

It is open to the international community that a dictator is an organization that controls the powers of the state.

A worker in TONG YING HK (Garment) said that even though they take leave for health issues, they are being considered absent.

"I was sick, so I asked to the all super myself for leave by phone. In addition, I reported through colleges the factory. But it is shown as A (Absence) by the all super. When I went to ask why they showed A although I reported, they replied just to talk with the all super," said a labour who was labeled as absent.

The factory officials did not pay attention to what the labours explained. The labours said that they are only processing the report of the super and all super (supervisor). The labours added that if they complain about the leave, they were told that they must report to Super and All Super, so they have notified both of them about the leave but they have not received the leave yet.

"They say don't come starting next day, if we asked to leave from the workplace due to serious ill conditions. So, the sick person has to work until faint. Even if I asked for permission to leave because I was really sick, they labeled me A(Absent) with the reasons of there were too many clothes. They also said at the meeting that no will be allowed to take leave,” he said.

More than 90 percent of labours in Myanmar's garment sector are female and the labours said that the health conditions of women garment labours are challenging because of the lack of health care in the country, having to stand full-time during work hours and full-time siting.

Discriminations of the TONG YING HK Garment all supers

labours at the factory say that the factory said that they treat all labours equally upon leave, but discrimination still exists.

“All supers’ little sister took a leave for a week for sick. They are giving leaves to those who are confident with them although they are saying we don’t discriminate. It’s not they don’t grant leaves; they give to whoever they want.

There are 21 cavities in TONG YING HK (Garment) factory, each machine line has supers, and 5 a all super appointed for 5 cavities.

How much it suffers to be labeled as absent although report for leave

Garment workers at TONG YING HK say that they will no longer receive, the clothing bonus given for working for a whole month, attendance bonus and annuity if A is labeled.

Annuity is not a bonus, but a seniority leave

A senior labour at the TONG YING HK Garment Factory explained that the cut 48,000 MMK of absent labeled although report for leave equal for 10 days of seniority leave.

"That 48,000 MMK is paid for seniority leave. As soon as A was exposed, the 48,000 was no longer available. We are gating hated by supers and all supers for the causal leave. If I set it as A, we would suffer until the end of the year. If legal leaves are granted, there can be no such damages," she continued.

Myanmar’s labor laws include casual leave, seniority leave and medical leave are prescribed. It is stipulated that 6 days of casual leave, 10 days of seniority leave and 30 days of medical leave must be given to a labour. After completing one year work, the labour will get 10 days of leave, and if they don't take it, they can negotiate with the factory to get wages for those days.

TONG YING HK garment workers cut wages without permission, which is the right of workers, and such cuts are clearly illegal.

The tyrant all super fired a labour for missing two days of work

Factory workers at TONG YING HK Garment factory say that the cavity all supers does not allow them to take a leave, and if they do not come to work for two days for any reason, they were even fired.

"They said that we would be fired, if we miss two days of leave. I was lucky enough to get a day for leave but when I ask leave for another day as I am not fully recovered, they said not to come back, resign and reapplied,” said a labour who encountered it.

Labours who don’t get leave are fired directly by all supers, and not allowed to report to factory officials to submit their resignations themselves.

As the factory officials accept everything that the supers and all supers say, the labours’ rights are being violated more and they are experiencing more difficulties at work. The labours also said that there is average 2 to 3 labours who are fired every month because of absence from work.

"The workers are very afraid as the all supers using the term firing frequently. A labor from outside of Yangon want to go back to hometown as their parents are sick. They said angrily that they would leave if they don’t get a leave, and the all supers told them to leave immediately. That's how unruly they are,” the labours said.

The labours also said that the all supers at the factory are doing whatever they want on the subordinatesbut they could not say anything despite their grievances due to threats of dismissal.

WCC members are elected

Title: Female labours from a Hlaing Thar Yar Garment Factory were forced to work overnight at the South Dagon FactoryOct 23, 2023
Content:
"Yesterday (October 9th) around noon, I was told that they had to go to work at a factory in the east of Dagon City as I called her. Can't contact her again at late night and today (October 10th) I was contacted early in the morning. They said they went out to buy snacks. The MAIYIBEI Garment Factory has been opened with foreign investments and is said to be manufacturing warm jackets with a workforce of around 500. The factory was re-opened in June of this year. Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: The labours of Huang Myoung Garment Factory asked for 7 nights and 8 days, but no settlement gotOct 19, 2023
Content:
As HONG MIAO Garment Co; Ltd which locates on No.4 Road, Thar Du Kan Industrial Zone, Shwe Pyi Thar has committed the highest violation of labor rights and then closed the factory, the labours waited 7 nights in the factory, but they had to go home without any settlement.

“They asked for 7 nights and 8 days, but didn't get an agreement. The labours took back the chairs they were sitting on. As water got into the factory and they got sick because of the paper got wet. We had an adjustment this morning. After almost 3 hours of adjustment, we didn't get any agreement. The labours had to go home with only what they paid," said a source close to the labours.

As HONG MIAO Garment Factory said that they will pay September's wages on October 5th due to the factory closing, the labours spent 7 nights and 8 days in the factory to request for certain points such as to compensate those who have less than 6 months of experience, to pay compensation to pregnant labours as they don’t have social security allowance, and to pay the same as before for the tap servicers and to get their wages immediately.

He also said that the factory opened a case of theft against the two labours who were waiting overnight for negotiations but the case was dropped and released later.

The labours also said that although officials from the Township Labor Departments as well as administrative organizations such as general administrations were involved in negotiating the demands, instead of paying the 1 month notice fee, damages specified in the labours’ rights law with the last salary without OT, the supervisor of Office of Labor Guidance told to pay the notice fee with only the basic salary with the favor of the employer.

Before the closure of the factory, the labours applied to the Labor Office to form a labor union, but there was no inspection and no form was given too. The employer found out the list of unionized labours from the head office, and fired 48 union members by the reason that they did not have orders.

In addition to the union-busting dismissals, the labours said that they will continue to file complaints to the brands and ILO due to rights violations, and will request the rest of the money by linking to international organizations.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: More than 50 labours were fired by accusing of posting online about illegal overtime workOct 14, 2023
Content:
Myanmar Bestfortune Garment factory officials had fired more than 50 factory labours accusing of posting online about illegal so that the negotiations are held currently.

According to a social media post about labours being forced to work all light and all night at that garment factory in Shwe Pyi Thar Township, 52 labours were fired without valid reasons, alleging that the labours working in the factory had reported the matter.

In recent months, factory officials have been calling all light, all night overtime without considering the labours’ condense. And they found out in the social media that the labours were unsatisfied about that.

On October 4, HR manager Daw Thander Oo, the employer’s interpreter Ma Than Than together with the WCC members, called the 26 labours of machine line No. 10 and told them that they would stop be laid off with a one month notice wages due to lack of orders.

As there are day laborers in the factory, the they did not accept the dismissal also because of only those 26 from line 10 would be dismissed out of the 3 lines that manufactures only orders. Therefore, they request the WCC team to resolve but instead WCC just confirmed the dismissal without any negotiations.

The labours vision is that the dismissal is caused by the employer’s opinion of the labours posted online and there are labour leaders from some organizations include among them.

As negotiations were not resolved, they were allowed to continue working, but since October 5, line 10 labours will no longer be sewing clothes.

On October 9th, the employer's representative, Daw Thandar Oo, called 52 labours from Line 10 to move to other departments. And said that if they could not move, they would lay off 15 workers with more than 1 year of experience and those with less than 1 year of experience by paying the damages according to the EC contract together with a notice fee.

Currently, the labours said that they won’t accept the factory's statements and will continue to negotiate.

Myanmar labour News learnt that Myanmar Bestfortune Garment Co. Ltd factory in Shwe Pyi Thar Industrial Zone operates with around 1,500 labours, and current manufacturing AMISU, CRAFT, CLIQUE, Springfield, LC WAIKIKI and CLASSIC brands.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Labours criticized the raise of allowance only 1,000 MMK after 5 yearsOct 14, 2023
Content:
5 years after the last minimum wage was set, the labours are criticizing and objecting the raise of only 1,000 MMK as a subsidy.

Last day, the National Committee for Setting the Minimum Wage announced that in addition to the minimum wage of 4,800 MMK for the 8-hour daily wage set in 2018, an additional subsidy of 1,000 MMK will be provided.According to the announcement, labours will receive a new minimum wage of 5,800 MMK per day.

However, some factory labours said that since the basic salary was not raised but it was increased as a support fee, and the overtime pay would be continued to calculate at the current minimum wage of 4,800 MMK, so there was no significant change.

"In2018,a bunch ofsweet potato leaves were 100 MMK which is now300MMK.The raise of the minimum wages price of4,800MMK set in2018has to5,800MMK is quite low. It should be doubled, if not tripled.It's sad for the workers. It only raises the minimum wages to 5,800 MMK. There is no change in overtime pay, so there is nothing special. Only a title,” said a factory labour.

In addition, there are also criticisms on in the announcement that the subsidy was raised by 1,000 MMK because only CMP factory and workshops are mentioned and it is not clearly described in the statement that whether labours from other business sectors can enjoy it or not.

“I know neither how the factories that pay 5,600 MMK would raise nor overtime payment would. The statement is not clearly issued. And where is the Employer, Employe and Government tripartite dialogue. Would it be in accordance with the law without this tripartite dialogue. Or is it a demonstration of power because of the couped era,” said a labour union member.

When the minimum wage was published in 2018, it was set to be 4,800 MMK per day and It was published without distinguishing the type of work and the region.

Since around that year, the labours asked for a minimum wage of 5,600 MMK. When they asked for a daily wage of 10,000 MMK after 5 years later, it was only increased by 1,000 MMK.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Labours who resign from Xinda Home Textile have been paid a reduced grade bonusOct 14, 2023
Content:
Xinda Home Textile from Shwe Pyi Thar Industrial Zone has reduced grade bonus on paying wages to the labours who quit their jobs, the workers said. In the last month before resigning, the labours said that they had not made any mistakes and had met fabric the standards, but the wages were reduced.

"The supervisors (supers) said that wages will be reduced if we resign. An A+ great grader is reduced to a C. Quitting is an understatement," said the labour who quit his job.

It is said that grade specifications in the factory are divided into A+, A, B and C. The labour also said that there is a difference of 15,000 kyats in entitlement money between these great levels.

“When the factory paid my wages, my grade A was reduced to grade B grade. Great A is 37,000 MMK. As for B, it is 22,000 MMK. The other disadvantage is that the daily allowance is 500 MMK for A level. B gets 300 MMK. Here too, around 6,000 MMK have been gapped," said a female labour who quit her job.

At Xinda Home Textile, around 20 people leave their jobs every month, and there are monthly interviews to replace those who have left. The female labour said that due to the financial damages, some of her plans to quit her job and study were affected.

"I quit my job to attend a distance learning university. I worked hard all month to pay for my studies. Being a big A, the monthly income is convenient for going to school. After leaving the job and paid the salary with a grade B, all my ambitions became hopeless,” she said.

The female labour said that there is neither provision nor announcement in the factory rules that the salary will be reduced if she quits like this. Also, one of the female labours who resigned said that the process of resigning was carried out according to the process, and they notified a week in advance.

"I informed that I will quit my job on the 23rdbut I worked until 30th. There was no mention in the factory that the salary would be reduced for quitting the job. Not in the EC contract either. The supers said that this grade reduction is caused by resigning,” she said.

She also said that although Xinda Home Textile (Myanmar) Co; Ltd Garment factory workers paid daily fee, pocket money and overtime pay, the reduction in salary after leaving the job was a huge loss for the labours.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: A letter from a labour at Kfine International Garment (Myanmar)Oct 14, 2023
Content:
Bago Kfine violates the rights of pregnant workers. Workers are not paid annuities, and the official of the labour office told them not to speak out. The labour office official breaches the ethics by revealing the name of the complainant to the factory.

#Letter From worker section(Uncut according to the sender's original dictation)

Labours from Kfine International Garment (Myanmar) Co.,Ltd. Factory at Bago city bypass road are forced to work in violation of EC Treaty.

In other factories, the annual salary, which is the right of the employees, is calculated once for a full year and the following month. Even they resigned, the factory informed them by phone to come and take the annuity.

In our Kfine factory, we do not issue pensions after completing one year of employment. Another is that it is only issued twice a year in April and October but not during the interval period even we resigned.

We complained about it when the labour office came to inspect it. The officers from the labour office said that annuity issue doesn’t count in their inspection, so they warned us not to tell anything. When the officials gone back, the HR Manager called us and scolded us. And because of this issue, they scolded us every day until the end of the month, so that I had to quit my job.

Even now, pregnant women are forced to submit resignation letters. Even though they paid social security fee for a year, they were forced to quit. Pregnant women are not allowed to leave work early, but Burmese-Chinese interpreters do leave ten minutes early for lunch. And leave early at the evening and aboard the ferry. The interpreter who abroad the seats in the ferry is a homosexual man and always brings a pillow with their and sleeps alone in the two people seat wherever they get to leave in advanced. They did not ask female to sit next to them but males. Pregnant women are always given a seat by the young girls sitting at the back of the ferry.

Burmese-Chinese interpreters eat snacks in the machine line, use smart phone all the time, flirting with girls in every cavity, perverting the girls whom they could, bring snacks for them, hug and touch them during working hours.

Cavity all super Daw Zin Mar Myint said to me, "You know that our factory does not accept gravid," and forced me to quit immediately.

All Super Jue Myat Naing always swear. She sycophantic with the Chinese woman in the line and become an A Super without any skills. She swears to the employees under her all the time. She doesn’t to know nothing if we ask her. But in front of the Chinese, she scolds and swears in a way that she knows everything. Every time she swears, she highlights with the thing under her dress.

The coming weekend is set as 5 days off for Tha Din Gyut but we were asked to substitute on Sundays. When we asked if they would pay 5,600 MMK for those days, they said “No, its just a substitution”. Our factory has 1,800 employees and 200 day laborers, a total of 2,000 labours.

70 employees have to take a single ferry. No response from the HR for reporting this. All super Daw Sander Win said “Work if you can or leave” when we reported to her. She said to come with our own car if we feel it is tight. They, the higher ranks always make sure a seat to be left for them but pregnant women were to stand up.

There are two shifts in the factory right now. One group who came 16:00 and one who came 7:00. We the one who came 7:00 never got to arrive without missing a single bus stop. They forced us to take a single bus with 80/90 people.

The factory has about 20 cavities and mainly manufacturing Best Seller Brand, Only Brand, and ZARA Brand.

If the officers from the labor office come, the leaders teach us the forms to answer in advance. The officials didn’t take any action even if we answer the truth while having a chance. The officers in the office took what was given to them by the factory and went back. The officials from the government office returned as soon as the Chinese people gave them money. If this continues, the exploitation upon us were continued to be occurred too.

(This letter was sent to Myanmar Labor News by the Kfine factory labours via Mail. The labours said that some of them were fired on unsubstantiated allegations that there were violations in the Kfine factory. laboural officials often come to inspect due to the violations, but nothing has changed but only some labours are always fired.)

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Sunday coffee factory labours are having to pay the social security benefits that their employer shouldOct 05, 2023
Content:
EVER SUNNY INDUSTRIAL COMPANY LTD’s subsidiary of Guiding Star Group Company Limited, a food factory, which made (Sunday, Rich, Grand Palace, Shalala) brand coffee is cutting the social security benefits contributions paid by the labours without letting then have the benefits.

The FGWM group reported that more than 300 labours are working at the factory locates in Shwe Than Lwin Industrial Zone, Hlaing Thar Yar Township, and their social security payments are being cut.

For private workers, the Social Security Law states that the employee must contribute 2 percent and the employer 3 percent for social security benefits.

The cut of the social security fee is the money include that both the employee has to pay and the money that the employer has to pay. We are having to pay that the employer should do. We are getting a cut of 2,880 MMKs for labours’ (2) percent and 4,320 MMK for employer’s (3) percent," expressed in the report.

According to the factory's solution dated October 3, the factory has only 180 labours, and the factory has paid both the employer's social security fee and the labours’ social security fees.

Here, the labor force mentioned by the factory is only 180, and it is also stated that these workers are earning more than 2 lakhs MMK per month at the rate of 4800 MMK per day.

According to the statements of the workers who complained to FGWM, pregnant labours are not allowed to take a leave, no responsibility if there is an injury in the workplace, and labeled some labours as day labourers in order to avoid the employee benefits such as casual leave, seniority leave, medical leave, maternity leave, attendance bonus and professional bonus.

It is reported that some of the labours working in the factory are working through an agency, and are not receiving full wages, and are being cut off every month by the agency that helped them hired.

It is known that the labours who work through the agency don’t have the rights to enjoy the benefits and being like the employer rent labours from the agency.

It is also said that they wants the officials to resolve the fact that the labours who involved in the domestic food production and distribution business are losing their labor rights and getting cut excessive wages.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: The Employer neglect the labours who waited overnight to get the wages and keep transporting the equipment.Oct 05, 2023
Content:
As HONG MIAO Garment Co; Ltd factory which locates in No.4 Road, Thar Du Kan Industrial Zone, Shwe Pyi Thar Township, Yangon Division has been closed, around 300 labours waited overnight in the factory to receive their wages, but the employer neglected and keep transporting the equipment.

In addition, the HR has opened a case at the Hlaw Kar police station against 2 of the labours who stayed overnight at the factory last night for stealing linen.

Currently, the labours have negotiated to receive their September wages and compensation for the closure of the factory, but they have not yet reached a settlement, and the labours say that they are seeing equipment being taken out of the factory.

Two labours were arrested and charged with theft. This is also a fake accusing one. We waited all night, but the employer didn't ask anything. No one came to ask including ministers and heads of the labor office. The employer did not say anything specific. The equipment in the factory is already being transported.The people they summoned were also there all night. They came and asked us frequently. As they were drunk, we sat on the front row and keep the girls behind. They came and asked if we were okay. They keep taking pictures," said a labour.

The factory will pay September's wages on October 5thfor the departure but the labours wanted September's wages to be issued as soon as the factory closed, and they waited outside at the factory because they wanted to wait two days off and get their wages on October 2nd. But without a solution, it is reported that they are transporting the materials in the factory on the morning of October 3rd.

Even though they had to wait overnight in the factory, the employer and the labor office opened a case of theft against the two workers instead of resolving and about 20 administrators and police officers recruited by the employer waited 200 meters in front of the factory workers and questioned them exactly four times.

Despite this presence, the employer did not negotiate with the workers, nor did officials from the Ministry of Labor come to ask questions, so the workers had to wait overnight inside the factory, and the employer also called the police.

“The factory is closed. Salary will be issued on the 5thof October. Those who could received compensation are told to came and take at 26th. Labours with more than 1 year service will be paid a compensation of 1 month ration and those who work for 6 months will be paid half of a month. The rest of the labours would not get anything. The labours want to get their salary as soon as it closes. The factory is closed, so we are not sure. They didn't tell us exactly where and when they would issue the salary,” said another labour.

As upon the factory’s departure the labours are appealing to give compensation for all of them, to give social security benefits to the pregnant women and also to give the tap servicers.

Before the closure the factory is manufacturing the Fieldcore Brand and other orders and when the labours formed a union to resolve the violations inside the workplace, the employer didn’t recognize the union and fired the leaders and members and later they issued a statement for the closure.

The latest information is that more than 380 labours have not yet been paid their September wages. It was announced on September 26 that the factory would be closed, but operations were suspended on September 29 and no exact details about paying the compensations have not yet expressed.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Labours come and wait for the payment of wages and damages at the HONG MIAO Garment Factory. The factory called the policeOct 03, 2023
Content:
The factory was closed on Friday, and they told me that the salary would be issued on the 5th, and the compensation would be issued on the 26th. All the workers came to ask about it on their own. HR called the police, and there were about 5 fully armed police," the labour said.

We want them to give us the day we arrived. There are 11 pregnant labours. We came to request those 4 points,” said a labour.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Need to be wary of soliciting money from online by encouraging of finding jobsOct 03, 2023
Content:
Victims said that there are fake job offers and money scams that will connect people who need jobs through social networks with fake companies’ recruitment.

These financial scams have been around for a long time and are now on the rise. Since the beginning of the Covid period, the domestic unemployment rate has increased. Due to the decrease in recruitment, fake job offers and scams become more common.

''I found it online. The job was a WiFi company posting that I had to work at on call service. So, I contacted them. As they said, I submitted the forms and they asked me to pay a service fee of 5,000 MMK. They have not answered the phone since then. When I called back, the announced phones were turned off. That's when I knew I was being scammed,'' said a job seeker living in Shwe Pyi Thar Township.

Currently, there are many online services to find and connect with job opportunities, and there are more scammers than ever.

In this fraud, the amount of money is paid from five thousand to tens of thousands of kyat, and victims are given an incentive to pay an additional percentage if they get the job, and the job application is accepted online scamming the money.

In addition to this, job seekers need to be aware that there are some scammers who sell job applications for 5,000 kyats and saying that they will find a job, accept the CV form and cut off contact.

''I don't want to work in a factory. I prefer that because I can find a job online. At first, I don't think he's a liar because he posted it in the care. Now I know that there are lies. I myself have not been cheated yet. You have to be careful. I'll believe it before,'' said a person trying to find a job.

According to the Ministry of Labor, there are 80 licensed employment agencies in the country.

Employers also connect with agencies to find workers. They are working on recruiting workers through job fairs and posting job advertisements in job search journals.

“There are labor offices that call for workers with advertisements. For factories, notices are posted at the factory entrance. Employees are informed. Also, there are job fairs and calls. You need to be careful when you see a recruitment from online. Some of them posted old posts and called back. There are some who misuse the company's name and make fake job offers,'' said a labor activist.

Domestically, there are very few complaints about fake job offers and online financial scams, and awareness of these processes is also weak.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: 30,000 MMK increase under the title of additional allowance for government employees, but no information has been released for the private sectors yetOct 03, 2023
Content:
The Junta council announced today (September 30) that government employees will receive an additional allowance of 30,000 MMK, but there has been no press release for the private sector.

Government employees will receive an additional allowance of30,000MMK starting from next October, and day workers working in the respective departments will receive an additional allowance of1,000MMKfor working8hours a day, the Junta has announced.

There is no news about this increase for private employees yet. The news that government employees will increase their wages has been coming out for the past few days.

"I would say that the time to adjust the minimum wage rate has already passed. The ministry pretends not to know. Now, I see that the increase only for the government employees under the title of additional allowance is just a joke. In fact, what about the government's wage that is equivalent to the times must also be increased for the private sectors," said a former member of the Basic Factory Union.

Locally, 4,800 MMK are set for an 8-hour working day, and currently, some factories are increasing it from 5,600 MMK to 7,000 MMK.

According to the statutory minimum wage law, wages should be paid according to the times, but the employers are only giving one thousand kyat more.

"Actually, people will only comfortable only if they get 10,000 MMK minimum. But right now, even though we work overtime both day and night, we are not comfortable. Now, if the salary of the employees is increased, I am worried about the good prices increasement too. I am seeing that we are going to face the double good price increasement whilst the wages they increase is only 1,000 MMK" said a labour working at a garment factory.

Since the coup, local labours have been facing violations of their rights and livelihoods due to insufficient wages.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: The labours of the SYNERGY Garment Factory in Hlaing Thar Yar say they are being forced to work without a single day offOct 02, 2023
Content:
It is reported that there are physical abuses and slanders against workers in the SYNER GARMENT factory which locates between Debayin Secretary Assistant Road, between A Sint Myint and Bogyoke, Hlaing Thar Yar Township.

The garment labours at the factory are being forced to work overtime without a day off even on Sunday, which is a holiday. It is reported that only a few labours get overtime pay, and most of them work without overtime pay.

“This week, we had to work continuously until 8pm. Even on Sunday too. labours are all exhausted. We are tired. All factory workers have to work on working days. They rest on Sunday and do homework. So that they don’t come on Sunday. Those were told not to come anymore. A girl even demoted to the helper from the cavity. Almost everyone is working for free. They are supposed to let go of us in 18:30 PM but forced us until 20:00. Most cavities don’t get overtime fees except the cutting lines. Some do but most don’t. Always hearing from outside that factory often forced free overtime. Most people don't want to work there,” said a labour.

The labours at that factory have been working overtime without pay for a long time, but they fired them for not working overtime on the Sunday weekend. It is reported that the demotions and slanderers have been perpetrated for about two months since the All Super arrived.

“Working overtime for free is since the past but slanders and abasements came to happen only after this all super recircuited. It has been two months. There are 3 all supers but only she does like this. Not allowing us gate pass too. She made us sign warning if we don’t work on Sunday and firing and demoting upon that too. There have been 3 people who have been fired for not working on Sunday,” she said.

The factory has about 800 labours and manufacturing warm clothes, and the labours say that they are having difficulty working because there is no solution to the violations and coercion in the workplace.

“All labours from All Super Ma (Miss) –‘s line sworn which is not in accordance with the law. She called us “Whore”. She didn’t teach some young labours at first but in stead she yell if they made some mistakes. She pulled their hairs. The juniors are tolerating only because they are scare,” said the labour.

Due to the violation of rights in the workplace, it is difficult to file a complaint with the relevant departments and the labours said that they wanted them to solve the problem so that they would not be forced to do so and would not be forced to work overtime for free. And they also want to give them a leave of absence and holidays.

Title: More than 2,000 labours at LAT WAR (3) garment factory are being violated upon their rights.Sep 30, 2023
Content:
According to the labours, more than 2,000 labours at the LAT WAR (3) garment factory which locate in Seik Kan Thar Street, Industrial Zone (2), Hlaing Thar Yar Township, Yangon are being violated.

The garment factory was opened more than (1) years ago, and there are days when the working hours are (8) am to 6:30 pm (2 hours overtime) and there are days when the labours work overtime (3 hours) and also the days where they work all night and all light with the ground of the fabric order importance.

“Working all light reach until the next day morning. They forced us to work all light 4 or 5 days continuously. We have health issues such as vomiting and fainting for that,” said the labour.

It is reported that the factory is owned by a Chinese national, employs more than 2,000 labours and manufactures brands such as REGATTA, KAPALUA, and has formed a Work Coordination Committee (WCC) without a trade union organization.

When called for overtime, labours have to work whether they want to or not, he said.

There are no lounges for labours who work overtime, and asking twice the standard even the prior is reached. It doesn’t have a normal format for the fabric standards and the Supers, Line Leaders and clerks swear and yell the labours, said by the labour.

Pregnant workers are not asked to do works that relieves them but force for the same records as ordinary workers, and they say that pregnant women didn’t allow to get the gate pass even if they are sick.

In addition, the labour also said that they are not allowed to take the days off that they are entitled to."There is no enough cough relieve medicine in a medical clinic where there are more than 2,000 labours. 20 out of 40 toilets in the factory are broken and have not fixed yet. Even if we go to the toilet, the supervisors yell at us," said a labour working in the factory.

Although 26th27thand 28thof Octobers are Tha Din Kyut holidays the employers will close from 26thto 30thbut 26thand 27thwhich are not officially entitled will have to replace by the September 24thwhere the labours work on Sunday and October 15thSunday where they have to do the same.

Those who don't show up on Sunday have been informed that the professional fee will be reduced to (2) levels, and the Great A person will only get C level. It is reported that the overtime work on the 23rd was only paid for 2 hours, and the remaining 4 hours of work were not paid but made to sign and print fingerprints due to day replacement.

As a result of the above violations, the labours are suffering a lot and feel that their rights are being violated. So that the labours want to request the following points because they are suffering from coercion.

Title: Galaxy (Myanmar) factory violating labour rightsSep 30, 2023
Content:
According to the Myanmar General Federation of Trade Unions FGWM, the Chinese man, the owner of the Galaxy (Myanmar) factory which locates in Hlaing Thar Yar Township, Yangon, demands an increase in fabric standards from the labours by hitting the machine seat in the workplace.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: HONG MIAO Garment closes after committing the violations upon the laboursSep 28, 2023
Content:
HONG MIAO Garment Co; Ltd which locates at the No (4) Road, Thar Dhu Kan Industrial Zone, Shwe Pyi Thar Township, Yangon closed the factory after committing the highest level of labour rights violations, according to those helping the labours.

"The guards were called to the Huan Myung factory. The owner did not come and said the factory would be closed. The boss did not come but sent the HR. Then they called the guards and threatened to sign and then close the work. The labours are not signing but they are planning to pressure and threaten the labours," said a labour.

"Hua Myung Factory closed the factory on the grounds that there were no orders on September 26 and sent notice to the workers. The factory has been open for more than a year. This is a factory that the ministry found out because of a series of violations of labor rights in a warehouse where they operated illegally in Thar Dhu Kan industrial zone. Although they conducted inspections in the factory, none of the demands of the workers were implemented because the employers were hand in glove with the inspectors. On September 6, they gave me the forms to register the organization, but the head of the Office of Labour Guidance did not issue Form 6 but ignore. In addition, they are failing to take action to meet the minimum wage. Would the factory really close? Would they cheat and open it again? Whether they want to abolish the formation of the union will have to continue to be monitored,” said an individual helping the labours.

As there are many violations in the factory, the labours applied to the head office to form a union, but they did not come and inspect it, nor give the Form 6. The employer found out the list of 48 labours who formed a union from the head office of labor, and fired those on the grounds that they did not have an order.

The 9 labours who were fired prior are also union members. This list of the labours was given to the entrepreneur by the head of the Office of Labour Guidance, and the entrepreneur fired according to this list. Line 2 was not paying by saying that there are no orders. Line 2 labours were sent to lines 3 and 4 but the rewards from those lines were not given to labours who were moved from Line 2.If they send the labours to Line 3 go, they have to pay them the same as the other labours of the line, and those labours sent a message that they can't pay less than one hundred thousand. There are many violations. Essentially, dropping all 48 members from 1 to 48 in the union is the most serious violation,” said the supporter.

On September 20, negotiations were held, and the fired labours returned to the workplace and said they would continue to negotiate with other violations, but the 9 union leaders were not reappointed.

The HONG MIAO Garment Co; Ltd factory is a factory that manufacture FieldCore brands. After settling the dispute on September 21st, the labours working in the factory are working in a dangerous workplace due to water entering the workplace, said by the supporter.

The water used in the factory is not clean and clear, they are using dirty water and there is no fan installed in the workplace, so the workers made demands. On September 26th, with the reasons of saying that there was no order, and they took out a notice to close the factory, said by the people who are helping with the labour issues.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Some labours are suffering from respiratory issues due to the manufacturing of asphalt in the garment factory yardSep 28, 2023
Content:
At the Amava Apparel Garment Factory in Pathein, Irrawaddy, some labours are suffering from headache and dizziness due to the smell of burning of asphalt around the factory as per the business requirements.

Although they say that they are manufacturing asphalt according to business needs, it has been going on for almost a month, and the labours say that they are having difficulty working because of respiratory problems, dizziness, and even headaches.

"Asphalt has been making to patch the roof of the factory for almost a month now. Even the regulatory department said that it is not possible to tell because it is according to business requirements. When they came to check on Friday at two o'clock in the afternoon, they said that it is not too bad, and nothing has been done," said the labour.

"Because of this pungent smell, the labours are dizzy, swollen, have headaches, shortness of breath, those who have gum disease and wounds are inflamed andthose who have had a C-section got stitches,” said a labour.

“We wish that they manufacture the asphalt on off days orafter the working hours. Now some got swollen gums and those who have had a C-section recently got stitches and headaches,” she continued.

The factory is owned by a Sri Lankan citizen and manufacturing the Blaklader brand with around 1,000 labours.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Gibaek Myanmar Co.,Ltd garment factory fired if labours miss just a daySep 27, 2023
Content:
The labours of the ibaek Myanmar Co.,Ltd garment factory which locates in Thaike Gyi, Yangon say that they are not allowed to take leaves and the factory even fire if they do.

“Firing them saying “don’t come anymore” for missing a day. They are firing 3 or 4 people per month,” said a female labour who is currently working inGibaek Myanmar Co.,Ltd garment factory.The woman also said that most of the people who were fired were fired because of taking leave.

Even though the labours pay social security contributions, they said that they are not given any leave such as medical and casual leave, and if they take a leave, they are informed about the dismissal through the line leaders.

"There was even a labour who is not allowed to take leave even with a hospital certificate of appendicitis. Labours are not fired by HR. but by the female all super. It's because it's kind of exposed at the bottom,” a female factory labour said.

The labours said that to sign an employment contract (EC) between the garment factory and the the labours require 3 months of services.

The Gibaek Myanmar Co.,Ltd garment factory is owned by a Korean citizen and the labours are being managed by the manager/all super (Daw-------).

"She said she take two positions and is directly firing employees. She didn’t even warn as first or second attempts but fire immediately,” said the female labour.

Gibaek Myanmar Co.,Ltd garment factory manufactures men and women wears and in addition it also produces the brand THE REDFACE based in South Korea.

It is said that if they want to go back home from the workplace due to reasons including health, they will not be given a gate pass from the factory and it is informed in a meeting involving all labours.

"They told us not to come out of the house if we are sick. They told us that we will not be allowed to return if we get to work," the labour said.

Gibaek Myanmar Co., Ltd. is a jacket factory that has been opened in Kan Taw Kan ward, Thaike Gyi Township for only 6 months. Currently, the factory is operating with around 300 labours.

Author: Translate By Kyaw Kyaw Win
Title: Labours’ rights are being severely violated at the HONG MIAO garment factorySep 24, 2023
Content:
STUM state HONG MIAO Garment Co. Ltd which locates at No.4 Road, Thar Du Kan Industrial Zone, Shwe Pyi Thar Township, Yangon as the factory with the highest violation of labor rights.

It is also reported that workers who formed a union to collectively solve workplace problems were fired from their jobs with the reasons that the employer saying not having orders.There are many violations of labor rights at the factory, and the workers formed a union to solve the problems at work and applied to the head office, but there was no inspection and no form was given.

According to the labour list of the 48 workers that formed the union, the head office informed the employer and began to expel the workers from the union one by one. It is reported that the 2 layoffs at first, 9 layoffs later and the 41 layoffs on September 18th caused union labours to be laid off for the reason that there were no orders.

“Nothing clears up the problem. It is only aimed at getting fired without solving. Form 6 is not given to form a union. The labours were fired on the pretext that there was no order. The people who were fired, were unknown unless the labour office inform. All people from the Line 2 are union members. Those who were removed from the other line were also people from the union. The 9 people prior are also people from the union. The head office gave the list of people to the employer, and the employer removed them according to this list. Removing Line 2 by saying there were no orders. People from line 2 are sent to other lines 3 and 4. But the rewards from that line were not given to people from line 2. If they let Line 3 go, Line 3 labours must receive the same as the other labours, and we also sent a letter saying that they can't pay less more than gapping one hundred thousand. A lot of violations. The main thing is firing all 48 people in the union, from 1 to 48, which is the most serious violation," said the person helping the labours.

That factory It is also said to be a factory that manufactures Hello and FieldCore brands.

“After 48 members of the union were fired, the three heads from the Office of Labour Guidance, Labour Office andOffice of Workshop and Labor Law Inspection Departmentmet with the labours when the employer's labor problem broke out. They kicked out all the labours, put the three union leaders in, and slammed the doors shut. And the owner did not sign on the agreement. The owner will remove the entire line where they were union members. He would remove it and make sure it will be mixed in the rest of the places. There is a super one among those fired. The employer didn't sign it, HR signed it. This morning, when I entered the factory, I don't know what all the heads of departments were talking about. The employer said that if Line 2 is not cancelled, no one will enter. The contract does not delete the line. Temporary replacement where necessary. The labours also asked why they had to cancel this line and work on other lines. The labours were fired on the grounds that there was no order," said the helper.

"The entrepreneur has agreed to the request of the labours. The head of Office of Labour Guidance cannot be satisfied that it is already convenient. He again asked to go to the place according to the needs of the business. It is no longer the era where he has to agree. It is not only the employers who are involved in violations. It is said that the heads of the divisions are also present." He continued to say.

The fired labours have returned to work, but negotiations will continue for many other violations.

On September 21, STUM urged that it is time to protest to the GSP of the European Union and condemned the ignorant actions of the Garment Manufacturers Association MGMA as the labours of the factory were working in a bad workplace due to the water entering the factory, and the lives of the labours were considered priceless due to the investments of the inhumane employer.
